stage: After the fair shared-cache persistent-AST measurements and before measuring the new default memory condition. No sample or transition selection changes.
observed_problem: Across all ten release-pair batches, persistent AST replay was slower than shared-memory full rebuild. Preserve this negative phase and remove AST JSON persistence from the default session path. Durable graph handles and source blobs remain separate.
decision: Default live sessions reuse process-local ASTs. Persistent AST JSON is optional. The fixed-root server retains a session between requests.
new_measurement: For every original release pair and adjacent transition, three paired repetitions of full current-revision shared-memory cache, old-to-current in-memory cache, and stable-current memory cache over the same 30 queries. Before-cache priming is untimed; source hashing/reading and graph persistence remain excluded.
publication: Keep initial renderer failures and compact-renderer persistent-cache negative results immutable under their diagnostic names. Append the memory condition; never reinterpret old persistent timings as memory timings. Exact graph IDs and all prior observations must remain unchanged.
